video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners what NULL means in SQL, why a row with a missing salary fails every ordinary comparison, and how IS NULL finds it

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

lists_exit.what: The two lists and the count of staff fade away

empty_box_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around each empty salary cell

null_pill_wipe.what: A lavender pill with the word NULL spreads from left to right inside each empty cell

not_equal_draw.what: A violet not-equal sign draws itself between the NULL pill and a chip

meaning_exit.what: The not-equal signs and the chips beside the table fade away

test_band_enter.what: A violet outlined band fades in over the first row of the staff table

test_band_step.what: The violet band slides down from one row to the next

test_band_exit.what: The violet band fades away after the last row

verdict_enter.what: A small chip reading true, false or unknown fades in beside a row when the band reaches it

row_dim.what: The text of a row whose verdict is not true fades from navy to pale gray

pass_chip_enter.what: A white chip with a violet outline fades in around the name of a row whose verdict is true

pass_travel.what: The name of a row whose verdict is true travels down behind the query card into the result table

pass_chip_exit.what: The chip around the travelling name fades away as it lands

condition_out.what: The condition in the query slides up and fades out

condition_in.what: A new condition slides up into the query in place of the old one

condition_underline_draw.what: A violet underline draws itself under the new condition

verdict_out.what: The old verdict chip beside a row fades out

verdict_in.what: A new verdict chip fades in beside the row in its place

result_row_exit.what: The name in the result table fades out when no row passes any more

table_restore.what: The pale rows of the staff table return to navy and the verdict chips fade away

counter_count.what: The number at the end of a counter chip counts upward steadily
